mapper.select: SELECT strategy_case.strategy_case_id, strategy_case.sku_id, strategy_case.requested_sales_point_id, strategy_case.case_code, strategy_case.case_name, strategy_case.case_status, strategy_case.generation_stage, strategy_case.recommendation_outcome, strategy_case.request_payload_json, strategy_case.result_cache_key, strategy_case.result_expires_at, strategy_case.failure_code, strategy_case.failure_message, strategy_case.completed_at, strategy_case.created_at, strategy_case.updated_at, strategy_case.created_by, strategy_case.updated_by, strategy_case.is_deleted, sku.sku_code, sku.sku_name, product.image_url, category.category_id, category.category_name, category.category_level, requester.user_id AS requester_id, requester.user_name AS requester_name FROM strategy_case strategy_case JOIN sku ON sku.sku_id = strategy_case.sku_id JOIN product ON product.product_id = sku.product_id LEFT JOIN category ON category.category_id = product.category_id LEFT JOIN app_user requester ON requester.user_id = strategy_case.created_by WHERE strategy_case.strategy_case_id = #{strategyCaseId} AND strategy_case.is_deleted = 0

SELECT sales_point_id, sales_point_code, sales_point_name FROM sales_point WHERE sales_point_id IN
#{salesPointId}

SELECT warehouse_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name FROM warehouse WHERE warehouse_id IN
#{warehouseId}

SELECT lot_id, lot_no AS lot_code FROM lot WHERE lot_id IN
#{lotId}
